run_stat_script: run the stat.py script to generate model zoo statistics from config README files
summarize_stat_script: summarize the stat.py script that parses README.md files and counts checkpoint URLs
review_stat_script: review the stat.py script that extracts checkpoint counts and generates model_zoo.md
refactor_stat_script: refactor the stat.py script to support configurable URL prefixes and output paths
test_stat_script: test the stat.py script to verify it correctly parses README.md files and counts checkpoints
